initial_plan.answerability: partly: the file can compare the motorist-versus-cyclist composition of recorded deaths in these two categories, but it does not represent deaths among all road-user types
initial_plan.metric: for each year, motorist deaths and cyclist deaths as percentages of their combined total, calculated from sums of the two killed-person columns
initial_plan.denominator: the annual sum of reported motorist deaths plus reported cyclist deaths
initial_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31
initial_plan.grouping: calendar year, with shares for motorist and cyclist deaths

data_check_facts_and_decisions.crash_date: No missing crash dates in the file (0); it is a DATE field, and all 13 requested years have full calendar coverage. Use all crashes dated within 2013-2025; no rows are excluded for missing dates within the requested period.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.population_size: There are 2,132,218 in-range crash rows total; yearly counts are recorded in check_2.csv (85,546 to 231,564). These are underlying crash population counts, not the share denominator.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.number_of_motorist_killed: 0 missing values among in-range crash rows; keep all in-range rows when calculating category totals.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.number_of_cyclist_killed: 0 missing values among in-range crash rows; keep all in-range rows when calculating category totals.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.year_coverage: 2013-2025 each has records from January 1 through December 31; none is partial.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.decisions: No data-driven exclusions or missing-value groups are needed. Denominator includes only summed motorist and cyclist deaths, so interpret shares as composition within those two categories, not all traffic deaths.

final_plan.answerability: partly: it compares the yearly composition of recorded motorist and cyclist deaths, but cannot show their shares of deaths across all road-user types
final_plan.metric: annual motorist deaths and cyclist deaths as percentages of their combined total, calculated from the respective sums of the killed-person columns
final_plan.denominator: within each year, the sum of recorded motorist deaths plus recorded cyclist deaths
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with a crash_date in calendar years 2013-2025, counting only the motorist and cyclist killed-person fields
final_plan.grouping: calendar year, with two shares: motorist and cyclist
final_plan.limitations: The denominator excludes pedestrian and any other road-user deaths, so the shares describe only the motorist-plus-cyclist subset. All requested years are full, crash_date has 0 missing values in the file, and neither killed-person field has missing values among in-range rows; no in-range rows are dropped for missingness.
